content.text: {"core": "Authority sets the rule and holds the line so a shared thing stays standing. In Culture, it works on what a group already agrees to keep — the settled ways everyone leans on. Overdone, the rule hardens past the agreement: the standing arrangement becomes one voice's command, and belonging turns into obedience. What was shared is now issued.", "sheetLine": "The shared way became one voice's order; agreeing turned into obeying."}
